required_concepts: Discrete variables are countable and have distinct categories with no in-between values
The number of volunteers is a countable quantity
optional_concepts: Continuous variables involve measurements that can take any value within a range
Time spent volunteering is a continuous variable but counts are discrete
misconceptions: Confusing countable quantities with measurable ones
Assuming duration rather than count determines classification
grading_notes: Emphasize distinction between counting (discrete) and measuring (continuous). Partial credit for mentioning both concepts but incorrect classification.
